hypothesis: In the t-7 unlock short (unlock_short_t7), trades on cliffs of at least 10% of unlocked supply earn a positive hedged return and earn more than trades on 5-10% cliffs. The source's 5% threshold dilutes the rule.

development_evidence.file: data/research/unlock_t7_big_v1/development_t7_5_stop40.csv, column basket_hedged: a rerun of scripts/unlock_short_backtest.py --min-size 5 --entry -7 --exit -1 --stop 0.4 made on 2026-11-05 from the study's cached bars
development_evidence.stale_file_warning: data/research/unlock_study/short_backtest_-7_-1_5.csv has the same name pattern but was left by a run with a 20% stop (no unstopped trade moved more than 19.9% against the short); it is not this rule and was not used
development_evidence.matches_source_reference: all 252 hedged trades: +3.56%, win 71%, which is the +3.6% / 71% the source tracker registered for this rule
development_evidence.sample: 273 trades on unlocks from 2022-12 to 2026-08, of which 252 (from 2023) have a hedged return; the study's basket has a median of 30 coins, the forward tracker's about 120
development_evidence.shape: a step at 10%, not a gradient: 10-20% is above 20%+, and the small book is weaker but still positive. The 2026-11-05 review's replay with no stop and a 126-coin basket showed 0.42 / 2.42 / 5.85 / 7.06 and -0.90 for small cliffs in 2026; those figures depend on that accounting and are not the rule tested here.
development_evidence.matched_control: data/research/unlock_study/matched_events.csv, event minus same-calendar same-age coin without an unlock, last 7 days before the unlock: >= 10% -9.15% (71 events), 5-10% -1.16% (115 events)
development_evidence.threshold_origin: 10% is the unlock study's original cliff threshold and the t-30 tracker's rule since 2026-09-27; it was not picked from the size buckets above. The split itself was proposed after the buckets were seen.
development_evidence.already_seen_and_excluded: forward trades of the source that entered before activation are development data: NOM +10.09, APR +38.80 (big); CARV -4.99, H -1.28, GUN -1.50 (small); late 2Z +16.25, late GUN +1.49
development_evidence.status: post hoc. This ledger is the first independent test.

source.access: read-only: the overlay never writes the source file or changes its trades, statistics or retirement
source.eligible: a source trade with a symbol and an exit day, not late, size_pct at least 5, whose entry close is after this ledger's activation. A trade the source discovered before activation is eligible if it has not entered yet: its outcome was unknown at registration.
source.entry_close: 00:00 UTC after the source's entry_day; the source enters at that close, 7 days before the unlock, and exits at the close 1 day before it
source.returns: the source's own settled figures: hedged_return_pct (primary; short coin + long frozen basket of coins with no cliff within 45 days, 0.2% per leg, real funding, +40% stop on daily highs) and short_return_pct (reference)

books.assignment: by the size_pct the source stored when it discovered the trade, which it never updates; recorded in the journal at the first cycle that sees the trade and never changed. A later schedule revision does not move a trade between books.
books.counted: closed, stopped and schedule_changed trades with a hedged return (schedule_changed must be counted, not hidden: the backtest could not see revisions)
books.void: source trade missing, late, entry_failed, or settled with an unresolved hedge: excluded from both books and reported
books.waiting: a settled trade whose hedge is still pending is not an outcome yet

analysis.unit: batch = trades of one book sharing an entry day; batch return = mean hedged return of its trades; a batch counts once every trade in it has an outcome
analysis.primary: mean hedged return of big batches

tests.absolute: one-sided sign-flip test of the big batches (statistic: mean; 10,000 draws)
tests.dose: one-sided permutation of the batch labels (statistic: mean(big) - mean(small); 10,000 draws)
tests.rng: numpy default_rng, the seed in parameters, a fresh generator for each test

analysis.review: one review, journaled once and then frozen: at the first cycle with 30 complete big batches, or 548 days (18 months) after activation, whichever first. By count it uses the first 30 complete big batches in entry-day order and the complete small batches entered on or before the last of them; by time it uses all complete batches. Before the review the summary is descriptive only and shows no p-value.

verdict.supported: big mean > 0, big mean > small mean, and both p <= 0.10
verdict.rejected: big mean <= 0 or big mean <= small mean
verdict.insufficient: fewer than 15 big or fewer than 10 small batches at the review

analysis.expected_power: resampling the development batches at 30 big and 30 small: if history holds, about 48% supported and 14% rejected (absolute test passes about 86%, dose test about 48%); if the big mean halves, about 13% supported and 47% rejected; with no edge, about 6% supported and 65% rejected. 'Inconclusive' is a likely result, mostly because of the dose test.
analysis.pace: the development data has 38 big and 52 small batches in its last 12 months, so 30 big batches would take about 10 months
analysis.reported: per-book batch and trade means, positive batches, worst trade, stop and schedule_changed counts, short-leg reference, void count, trades recorded after their entry close
analysis.no_tuning: no change of thresholds, unit, review or tests after activation; a change needs a new protocol id and directory

limits: The development data covers tokens still listed by DefiLlama and Binance when the study ran, and uses the schedule as known then. Survivorship and later schedule revisions can flatter it.
Tokens repeat, especially in the small book (GUN and H vest monthly). Batches of one token are not independent evidence about that size class.

A cliff size can be revised after discovery; the book stays. A big trade revised to 5-10% stays open and stays big, because the source closes a trade as schedule_changed only below its own 5% threshold or when the date moves more than 3 days.

All rules of the source tracker are inherited (entry, stop, basket, costs). If the source's code changes or it stops creating trades, this ledger follows it; the activation record stores the source module's SHA-256 so a change can be seen.
Paper returns at daily closes: no check of borrow availability, order-book depth or a real account's drawdown.

integrity.journal: data/research/unlock_t7_big_v1/journal.jsonl, append-only and hash-chained; each record carries the SHA-256 of this file and core/research/unlock_t7_big_ledger.py; any change stops the journal
integrity.paper_only: records only; never places or proposes orders
